recipe.description: Rina Holt original art direction: compact upright head, broad but restrained cheek plane, rounded chin with clear jaw turn, short projecting nose and a substantial neck. The graphical target labels do not establish biography, age, ethnicity or gender identity; existing appearance palette stays independent.

source_indices: All source vertex/UV/face/triangle indices are zero based. Face IDs count every OBJ f line. Triangle IDs count every original face fan triangle, including discarded body regions and helper groups.
lod: Original retained face topology is shared. No simplification or detail-destroying decimation is applied.
